import Definitions.Def_AbcAdaptation_Reference_Iut_Tripod_FieldInvariant
import Definitions.Def_AbcAdaptation_Reference_Iut_Cor312_ThetaData_GlobalField
import Mathlib.NumberTheory.NumberField.Discriminant.Different

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AbcAdaptation.Reference.Iut

universe u

open NumberField WeierstrassCurve

/-- The normalized degree `log(d_L) = log N(𝔡_{L/ℚ})/[L : ℚ]` of the different divisor of a
number field `L` (IUT IV, Theorem 1.10: `deg(d_ADiv)`). -/
noncomputable def logDifferentDeg (L : Type*) [Field L] [NumberField L] : ℝ :=
  Real.log (Ideal.absNorm (differentIdeal ℤ (𝓞 L))) / Module.finrank ℚ L

section Tripodal

variable (F : Type*) [Field F] [NumberField F] (E : WeierstrassCurve F) [E.IsElliptic]

variable (VBad : Set (FinitePlace ↥(fieldOfModuli F E)))

/-- A finite place of `F_tpd` is **bad** if a bad place of `F` lies over it. -/
def IsBadTpdOf (𝔭 : FinitePlace ↥(tripodalFieldOf F E)) : Prop :=
  ∃ w ∈ badPlacesOver F E VBad, FinitePlace.LiesOver w 𝔭

open scoped Classical in
/-- The normalized degree `log(f_{F_tpd})` of the **conductor divisor** of `F_tpd`: the
sum of `log N(𝔭)` over the bad places of `F_tpd`, divided by `[F_tpd : ℚ]` (finitely
supported; `0` if not). -/
noncomputable def logConductorDegOf : ℝ :=
  (∑ᶠ 𝔭 : FinitePlace ↥(tripodalFieldOf F E),
    if IsBadTpdOf F E VBad 𝔭 then Real.log (Ideal.absNorm 𝔭.maximalIdeal.asIdeal) else 0) /
    Module.finrank ℚ ↥(tripodalFieldOf F E)

end Tripodal

namespace EllipticCurveData

variable (C : EllipticCurveData.{u})

/-- The set `V_mod^bad` attached to the prime `ℓ` ((P5) in the proof of IUT IV,
Corollary 2.2): the places of `F_mod` of residue characteristic `≠ 2, ℓ` over which `E`
has multiplicative reduction (at every place of `F` above, and there is one). -/
def VBadOf (ℓ : ℕ) : Set (FinitePlace ↥(fieldOfModuli C.F C.E)) :=
  {v | residueChar v ≠ 2 ∧ residueChar v ≠ ℓ ∧
    (∃ w : FinitePlace C.F, FinitePlace.LiesOver w v) ∧
    ∀ w : FinitePlace C.F, FinitePlace.LiesOver w v → HasMultiplicativeReductionAt C.E w}

end EllipticCurveData
end AbcAdaptation.Reference.Iut
natural_language_statement:
**English**

The normalized logarithmic different is the logarithm of the absolute norm of the different, divided by the field degree over $\mathbb Q$. A place of the tripodal field is bad when a prescribed bad place of the curve field lies over it. The normalized logarithmic conductor sums the logarithms of the norms of the bad places and divides by the tripodal field degree. The sum is zero when its support is infinite. For an index $\ell$, the prescribed bad places start from places of the field of moduli of residue characteristic different from $2$ and $\ell$. At least one place must lie over each such place, and every place above it must have multiplicative reduction.

**简体中文**

归一化的对数不同理想项是不同理想的绝对范数的对数除以域在 $\mathbb Q$ 上的次数。若曲线定义域中有指定的坏处位于三脚域的某处上方，则该处为坏处。归一化的对数导子把各坏处的范数的对数求和，再除以三脚域的次数。若支集无限，则此和定义为零。给定指标 $\ell$，从模域中剩余特征不同于 $2$ 和 $\ell$ 的处选取指定坏处。所选每个处上方须有至少一个处，且其上方各处均为乘法约化。

**日本語**

正規化対数不同は、不同イデアルの絶対ノルムの対数を $\mathbb Q$ 上の体の次数で割った値である。曲線の定義体の指定された悪い素点が三脚体の素点の上にあるとき、その素点を悪い素点とする。正規化対数導手は、悪い素点のノルムの対数の和を三脚体の次数で割った値である。台が無限のとき、和の値は零とする。添字 $\ell$ に対し、モジュライ体で剰余標数が $2$ と $\ell$ のいずれとも異なる素点から指定の素点を取る。それぞれの素点の上には少なくとも一つの素点があり、その上にあるすべての素点で乗法的還元を持つ。
source: Shinichi Mochizuki, Inter-universal Teichmüller Theory IV, Theorem 1.10 and (P5) in the proof of Corollary 2.2. Exact formal source in Iut/Concrete/Invariants.lean, logDifferentDeg, IsBadTpdOf and logConductorDegOf, and Iut/Concrete/Existence.lean, VBadOf. https://github.com/lana-agents/iut/blob/07cb1da58f6d428a670dbb5dd6093d428bcbcdd8/Iut/Concrete/Invariants.lean#L182 https://github.com/lana-agents/iut/blob/07cb1da58f6d428a670dbb5dd6093d428bcbcdd8/Iut/Concrete/Existence.lean#L95
